title: Two Centuries of Sexism in British Parliament: A Computational Analysis of Women's Representation in the Hansard Corpus
abstract: arXiv:2608.30485v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: The language a legislature uses to debate women's rights, even in favour of them, encodes systematic patterns of sexism that persist across two centuries. In this work, we analyse 6,531 speeches over 200 years of UK parliamentary debate (Hansard, 1803-2005) by using large language models to classify a speaker's perspective towards women's suffrage and political representation, as well as analyse sexist speech in parliament from the lens of the Ambivalent Sexism Inventory. We also release this parliamentary dataset, an organized and metadata-enriched version of the publicly available Hansard Corpus optimized for computational social science research, with 6.7 million speeches across 1.2 million debates, with 89% gender-matching for speeches by MPs from the House of Commons. translated_title: 英国议会两个世纪的性别歧视：基于Hansard语料库的女性代表权计算分析
translated_abstract: 立法机构在辩论女性权利时所使用的语言，即使是支持女性权利的，也蕴含着跨越两个世纪的系统性性别歧视模式。在这项工作中，我们分析了英国议会辩论200年间（Hansard，1803-2005）的6,531篇演讲，利用大语言模型对发言者关于女性选举权和政治代表权的立场进行分类，并从矛盾性别歧视量表的角度分析议会中的性别歧视言论。我们还发布了这一议会数据集，这是公开可用的Hansard语料库的经过整理并丰富元数据的版本，专为计算社会科学研究优化，包含120万场辩论中的670万篇演讲，下议院议员演讲的性别匹配率达89%。我们发现，反对女性代表权的演讲中有54%包含性别歧视内容，而支持该事业的演讲中这一比例仅为21%，且双方使用……
tldr: 该研究利用大语言模型分析了英国议会200年间（1803-2005）关于女性代表权的6,531篇演讲，发现反对女性代表权的演讲中54%含有性别歧视内容（支持方仅为21%），并发布了包含670万篇演讲、元数据丰富的Hansard议会数据集。
en_tdlr: Using large language models to analyze 6,531 speeches from 200 years of UK parliamentary debate, this study finds that 54% of speeches opposing women's representation contain sexist content versus 21% of supportive ones, and releases a metadata-enriched Hansard dataset of 6.7 million speeches for computational social science research.
